SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Dua (Supplication s) Dua On Increase In Knowledge, part of Akhlaq (Moral Teachings) in Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What is the importance of reciting dua always?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
